fields.label: Tenant code (Mã khách thuê)
fields.helpText: FOREIGN KEY. Must repeat the parent tenant record's Tenant code exactly. This form is the private half of the tenant file — the security boundary is the form itself.

validation.patternMessage: Must match an existing tenant code, e.g. KT-0001.

fields.label: National ID number (Số CCCD / CMND)
fields.helpText: DEMO DATASET ONLY. The pattern forces a DEMO- prefix so the value can never collide with a real Vietnamese 12-digit citizen ID. Never type a real number here.

validation.patternMessage: Demo IDs only: DEMO- followed by exactly 9 digits, e.g. DEMO-000000001.

fields.label: ID card photo (Ảnh CCCD / CMND)
fields.helpText: Front and back. Fictional sample images only.

fields.label: Signed contract scan (Ảnh hợp đồng đã ký)
Move-in equipment condition photos (Ảnh hiện trạng thiết bị lúc nhận phòng)
fields.helpText: Up to 12 images. maxFiles is set in the schema JSON directly because the builder's File Settings panel does not write it back.

fields.label: Move-in checklist note (Biên bản bàn giao - ghi chú)
Demo marker (Dấu dữ liệu demo)
fields.helpText: Seed marker. All rows carrying DEMO-RENTAL-2026 are fictional demo data and can be bulk-deleted.
